(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.iso-plate').getBoundingClientRect(); const out = []; for (const pt of [[462,552],[520,572],[560,580]]) { const els = document.elementsFromPoint(r.left + pt[0], r.top + pt[1]).filter(e => e.tagName === 'path').slice(0, 4).map(e => (e.getAttribute('class') || '') + '|' + (e.getAttribute('data-tone') || '') + '|' + (e.closest('.it') ? e.closest('.it').dataset.a : '') + '|' + (e.getAttribute('d') || '').slice(0, 50)); out.push(pt.join(',') + ': ' + els.join(' ## ')); } return out.join(' // '); })()
